_note: Wheelbase, track and stock tire OD match the model blocks in vehicles.js (published OEM spec sheet figures; estimates until a tape confirms them). bodyWidthIn is the published overall width without mirrors and only sizes the stand-in body. source is relative to configurator/public/models/.

f250-crew._note: Shipped body is the fictional Lightbody pickup stretched by prepare-lightbody.py to the 2017+ crew cab 6.75 ft bed wheelbase. A de-badged 2017-2022 Super Duty SRW crew cab derived from the f450 source (bed shortened 16.4 in, DRW flares off) is the planned replacement. See configurator/public/models/LICENSES.md

f150-crew._note: Shipped body is the fictional Lightbody pickup stretched by prepare-lightbody.py to the SuperCrew 5.5 ft bed wheelbase. A de-badged 14th-gen F-150 body is the planned replacement. See configurator/public/models/LICENSES.md

f450-crew._note: 2017-2022 F-450 crew cab 8 ft bed, DRW. Factory LT225/70R19.5 is 31.9 in OD. Source model is real scale; see configurator/public/models/LICENSES.md

gm2500-crew._note: 2020+ Silverado 2500HD crew cab, standard bed, SRW. Stock LT275/70R18 is about 33.2 in OD. Source is the 2015-2019 body, scaled uniformly to this wheelbase; see configurator/public/models/LICENSES.md

gmc2500-crew._note: 2020+ Sierra 2500HD crew cab, standard bed, SRW. Same dims as the Silverado HD. Source scaled uniformly to this wheelbase; see configurator/public/models/LICENSES.md

ram1500-crew._note: 2019+ RAM 1500 (DT) crew cab, 5.7 ft bed. Stock 275/65R20 is about 34.1 in OD. Source is the TRX wide body on 35s, lowered to the platform stock tire; see configurator/public/models/LICENSES.md
